template_grounded_facts.text: The feature-request template is the relevant issue template for this request; it asks for a description of the feature and an example of the problem it would solve, but the template text does not establish a firm missing-data requirement from the reporter’s submission.

live_browser_smoke_test.interpretation: Two Markdown templates were retrieved; the agent cited the applicable feature template and kept required flags unknown.

known_quality_issue.description: A detailed PNG report can still receive needs-info based on optional diagnostic questions. A single passing regression does not establish stability.

limitations: Only the current repository's .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE directory is read; inherited, legacy and nested templates are not searched.
At most two files are attempted. File size, field count, excerpt and shared context limits can yield partial coverage.
YAML extraction is not full GitHub schema validation. Markdown headings do not establish required fields.
Matching a template and deciding whether information is absent remain model judgments requiring human review.
The fixed five-case regression and one live browser example do not establish production quality.
